name: article-dossier
title: Article review dossier
for_each: select id,title as name from articles order by title

sections.title: Revision text
sections.sql: select version,body,editor,note,created_at from revisions where article_id=$1 order by version

sections.title: Review evidence
sections.sql: select version,reviewer,decision,evidence,created_at from reviews where article_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Reader corrections
sections.sql: select note,status,resolution from feedback where article_id=$1

name: owner-review
title: Owner review pack
for_each: select id,name from authors order by name

sections.title: Articles
sections.sql: select title,status,review_due,privacy_class from articles where owner_id=$1 order by review_due nulls first

sections.title: Open corrections
sections.sql: select a.title,f.note,f.priority from feedback f join articles a on a.id=f.article_id where a.owner_id=$1 and f.status='open'

sections.title: Personal information including archived records
sections.sql: select title,status,purpose,retention_review,privacy_checked_at from articles where collection_id=$1 and privacy_class='personal'

sections.title: Checks requiring a person
sections.sql: select c.title,c.rule,c.finding,c.source from compliance_findings c join articles a on a.id=c.id where a.collection_id=$1
